compatibilityReview.reviewer: DOC-030 independent walkthrough and compatibility reviewer agents (one seat per article group, independent of the source-review authors)
compatibilityReview.summary: DOC-030 (#1157) re-verified the suite against labs built from 067c1646. Each guide whose text or underlying behavior changed received a source review and an independent agent walkthrough for every required role and method on that build. Seven guides the app-diff triage left unchanged carry a compatibility review with replayed DOC-029 scripts. configure-analysis used a live OpenRouter key, and connect-claude and the public deployment profile used a live claude.ai session with the owner. 60 of 62 guides pass. connect-chatgpt and connect-microsoft-365-copilot await live vendor sessions under DOC-031 and receive no credit.
